stem: Meera watches the Sun set from her balcony in Jaipur in the evening, while her cousin in school learned that it is already night in some other parts of the world. What causes day and night on Earth?

options.text: Earth orbiting the Sun once every year
Earth rotating on its axis, turning each place towards and away from the Sun
the Moon blocking the Sun's light every evening
the Sun moving around Earth once a day

teacher.key_rationale: Day and night occur because Earth rotates on its axis, carrying each location alternately into the side facing the Sun (daytime) and the side turned away from the Sun (night). Option A describes the cause of seasons/year length, C confuses night with an eclipse, and D is the geocentric misconception.
